meta.parties: Idroos Sathuk v. Sittie Leyaudeen.Et Al

rules.statement: A Muslim widow is entitled to be regarded as the natural guardian of her minor children under Roman-Dutch Law, and this status allows her to accept a gift on their behalf.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not see anything intrinsically objectionable, in these circumstances, in regarding Fatheela Umma, in the Roman-Dutch Law sense, as a natural guardian entitled to accept the gift on their behalf."
